execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"

CREATE TABLE "public"."achievement" (
  "active" bool NOT NULL,
  "criteria" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "key" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "reward" int8 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."binder" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "isPublic" bool NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."binderSlot" (
  "binderId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "ownershipId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "page" int4 NOT NULL,
  "position" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "binder_slot_page_nonnegative_4d7c2ab8" CHECK (page >= 0),
  CONSTRAINT "binder_slot_position_nonnegative_c03c2ccb" CHECK (position >= 0)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."card" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "externalId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "imageLarge" text NOT NULL,
  "imageSmall" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "number" text NOT NULL,
  "rarity" text NOT NULL,
  "setId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."cardOwnership" (
  "condition" text NOT NULL,
  "firstAcquiredAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "lastAcquiredAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "quantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "userId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "variantId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "card_ownership_quantity_positive_4402679f" CHECK (quantity > 0)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."cardPrice" (
  "currency" text NOT NULL,
  "high" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "low" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "market" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "mid" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "recordedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "source" text NOT NULL,
  "variantId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."cardVariant" (
  "cardId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "finish" text NOT NULL,
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "isCollectible" bool NOT NULL,
  "language" text NOT NULL,
  "variantType" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."favoriteCard" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "ownershipId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "userId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("userId", "ownershipId")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."idempotencyKey" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "key" text NOT NULL,
  "operation" text NOT NULL,
  "response" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "userId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("key")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ledgerEntry" (
  "amount" int8 NOT NULL,
  "balanceAfter" int8 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "referenceId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "referenceType" text NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "walletId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "ledger_entry_amount_nonzero_8af7f6c8" CHECK (amount != 0)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."marketListing" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "ownershipId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "price" int8 NOT NULL,
  "quantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "sellerId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "marketListing_status_check_72091938" CHECK ("status" IN ('active', 'sold', 'cancelled', 'expired')),
  CONSTRAINT "market_listing_price_nonnegative_faabb23d" CHECK (price >= 0),
  CONSTRAINT "market_listing_quantity_positive_4402679f" CHECK (quantity > 0)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."marketTransaction" (
  "buyerId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "listingId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "price" int8 NOT NULL,
  "purchasedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "sellerId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."outboxEvent" (
  "attempts" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "eventType" text NOT NULL,
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "payload" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "processedAt" timestamptz,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "outboxEvent_status_check_29e2c2cd" CHECK ("status" IN ('pending', 'processed', 'failed'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."pack" (
  "active" bool NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "price" int8 NOT NULL,
  "setId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "pack_price_nonnegative_faabb23d" CHECK (price >= 0)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."packOpening" (
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "openedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "result" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "userId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "userPackId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."packSlot" (
  "count" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "packId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "position" int4 NOT NULL,
  "slotType" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "pack_slot_count_positive_2202e1ab" CHECK (count > 0)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."packSlotRule" (
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "packSlotId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "rarity" text NOT NULL,
  "variantType" text NOT NULL,
  "weight" numeric NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "pack_slot_rule_weight_positive_7c35b28d" CHECK (weight > 0)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."quest" (
  "active" bool NOT NULL,
  "criteria" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "key" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "reward" int8 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."set" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "externalId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "logoUrl" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "releaseDate" date NOT NULL,
  "series" text NOT NULL,
  "symbolUrl" text NOT NULL,
  "totalCards" int4 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."setProgress" (
  "calculatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "completionPercent" numeric NOT NULL,
  "setId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "totalCards" int4 NOT NULL,
  "uniqueCards" int4 NOT NULL,
  "userId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("userId", "setId")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."trade" (
  "completedAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "initiatorId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "receiverId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "trade_status_check_dd593ee5" CHECK ("status" IN ('pending', 'accepted', 'declined', 'expired'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."tradeItem" (
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "ownershipId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "quantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "tradeId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "userId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "trade_item_quantity_positive_4402679f" CHECK (quantity > 0)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "discordId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "username" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."userAchievement" (
  "achievementId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "earnedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("userId", "achievementId")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."userPack" (
  "acquiredAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "openedAt" timestamptz,
  "packId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "userPack_status_check_77934cc0" CHECK ("status" IN ('unopened', 'opened'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."userQuest" (
  "completedAt" timestamptz,
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "progress" int4 NOT NULL,
  "questId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "startedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "userQuest_status_check_87fdcf45" CHECK ("status" IN ('active', 'completed')),
  CONSTRAINT "user_quest_progress_nonnegative_af0dfc79" CHECK (progress >= 0)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."wallet" (
  "balance" int8 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "wallet_balance_nonnegative_f70191a8" CHECK (balance >= 0)
)
